recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中一顆大型巨核細胞，核高度分葉、分散成多個圓形葉片，細胞質豐富，旁邊有大片血小板聚集；成熟且過度分葉的大型巨核細胞搭配血小板增多背景，符合本態性血小板增多症（ET）。
features: Large megakaryocyte with abundant pale basophilic cytoplasm
Markedly hyperlobulated nucleus with many separate rounded lobes
Mature nuclear chromatin without hyperchromatic cloud-like atypia
Large adjacent sheet of aggregated platelets, suggesting platelet production/thrombocytosis
Admixed neutrophils, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant cytoplasm and a markedly hyperlobulated nucleus composed of multiple rounded lobes with mature chromatin. An adjacent large platelet aggregate is present, and the background contains maturing granulocytic and erythroid cells and lymphocytes. There are no dysplastic small hypolobated megakaryocytes in this field. Findings are consistent with essential thrombocythemia, pending correlation with platelet count, bone marrow biopsy architecture and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation status.

ddx.vs: Prefibrotic PMF shows megakaryocytes with high N:C ratio and hyperchromatic, irregularly folded cloud-like nuclei in tight clusters, best assessed on biopsy.
CML megakaryocytes are small and hypolobated ('dwarf') with marked granulocytic hyperplasia and BCR::ABL1 positivity.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: This entity shows ring sideroblasts and dyserythropoiesis in addition to large megakaryocytes.
